entities.summary: Arthur Reinmann (1901–1983) was a Swiss weightlifter who competed in the 1924 and 1928 Summer Olympics. In 1924 he won a bronze medal in the featherweight class. Four years later he finished fifth in the 1928 featherweight competition.
